data.name: Ejlaal
data.gender_notes: Ejlaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alala', meaning 'to be high, lofty, or elevated'. In Islamic contexts, it symbolizes the exalted status of Allah and the spiritual journey of believers towards Him. The name Ejlaal carries the meaning “Elevated, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ejlaal usually hope their child will grow to embody elevated, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ejlaal is a name that embodies the essence of divine light and radiance. It is believed to inspire feelings of inner illumination and enlightenment, as well as a deep connection to the natural world and the beauty of creation.
data.etymology: Ejlaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elevated, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ejlaal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
